title: Study notes and flashcards
audience: For students who want an AI study partner that remembers what they keep getting wrong.
description: A free flashcard maker and study app in a note: paste your notes and your AI makes flashcards. Study the cards that are due, one at a time.
tagline: Flashcards that come back when due.
seoTitle: Flashcard maker and study app for ChatGPT and Claude
note:
Study notes and flashcards

Add your first cards in the app, or paste your notes into your AI and it makes them. Cards you miss come back sooner; cards you know wait longer.

## Notes
Your notes on each topic, under a heading of its own.

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Study notes and flashcards". It is an app; its data is "Study notes and flashcards.app/data.json", beside the note. Read it with fetch before each change. When I paste lecture notes or a chapter, make five to ten flashcards with edit: add { id, q, a, topic, box: 1 } to values.cards, after any I've made myself. When I say "quiz me", ask me one card at a time, lowest box first, without showing the answer. After each answer, tell me if I was right and update the card as the app does (its docs/README.md): seen today; right: interval times ease (2 if new); wrong: interval 1, box 1. Add 1 to values.studied under today's date. I can add, edit and delete cards in the app myself.

asks: Ask me for the notes I want to study, then make flashcards from them, next to any I've added.
Quiz me on biology, ten cards.
Which cards do I keep missing?
